steps.content: The battle ends as swiftly as it began. Saffar flicks Hella's weapon aside, then pins her down in a single motion.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...She's one of the two DisCity people who went missing yesterday.
Head bowed, vision blurred by the searing pain of Mania's resonance, Hella can only listen as footsteps approach. It's the director.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Wait, hold on.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: I've heard the shackle user and Sinners affect each other. I wonder... does that connection hold even beyond WhiteSands?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hey! What are you talking about? What are you planning to do?!

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Lock her up. SHP-13's Sinner. She'll be invaluable to us.
[Scene Transition: Test Subject Cell]
In the haze of her consciousness, Hella feels herself being carried to someplace else. A door clangs shut, followed by the heavy sigh of someone.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: ...You shouldn't have come here...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: ...The weak, no matter how hard they struggle...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh...

The floor beneath her is wet, sticky. When her hands press into it, the sensation is vile, like sinking into a pool of rotting flesh. The Mania in the air seeps into her being, clawing through her dazed state to burrow into her bones, gnawing at her mind like a ravenous thing.
She drags in ragged breaths, fighting against the pain. Finally, with a shuddering effort, she lifts her head.

A prison cell. The torchlight is feeble, barely pushing back the gloom. What little illumination there is reveals uneven walls encased in metal frames. Deep, frantic scratches gouge the stone—the desperate work of past prisoners who had tried, and failed, to escape.
Then—movement. A shifting in the dark. The wet slide of limbs dragging across the floor. No, it's not her imagination.
Monsters slowly crawl out from the darkness, writhing as they gradually close in.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the hell...?! Get away... Don't touch me...!
Hella jerks back, but the wall is already there, unyielding against her spine.

The scrape of shackles against the ground snags her attention. Only then does she see what's wrong with them. Each creature bears Aurum Secretum shackles fused into their bodies, some jutting through shoulder blades, others driven deep into spines. The restraints don't just bind them; they puppet what's left of their twisted, no-longer-human forms.
One of them writhes forward, silent as it closes in on Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You are...
This alchemic beast is tiny in size. With no eyes, it navigates by scent alone. Then, with unsettling gentleness, it presses against Hella's cheek.
Its flesh trembles, and from its mouthparts come fractured, guttural words, barely intelligible.
...Mo... Mom?

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: My boy... You picked my boy...!

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: My poor little Yuri... Is he doing all right now? Has he recovered? I-I...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're... Sandra's...
The small alchemic beast doesn't stop. It nudges closer, its face nearly touching hers.
The stench of decay thickens. Hella has nowhere to retreat. She turns her face away, only to see the wall beside her riddled with scratches.

At first, they seem like mere gouges from some past violence. But as her vision sharpens, the marks resolve into something worse: uneven grooves, caked with dried blood, forming letters carved by something desperate.
<size=40>So hungry</size>　　　<size=50>Everything hurts</size> When will I get better?
They all stopped moving　 WHY 　Don't <size=50>leave</size> me here
Let me <size=40>out</size>　 I don't want this anymore, I want to leave
<size=40>How long<size=40> have I been here<size=40>　 Am I still <size=40>alive</size>? <size=40>No　 I'm not a failed product<size=40> HELP ME<size=40>
<size=40>No, I'm not a failed product<size=40></size>　　I　　I am...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ngh...!
The text warps in her vision as darkness creeps inward. Voices overlap, echoing in Hella's ears—battering her consciousness, dragging her toward the abyss. She struggles, but the pull is relentless.
Suddenly, her fingers brush against something. Another set of markings, deeper than the rest, their edges sharp. They twist across the stone wall, consuming nearly the entire surface.
—Frenzied writing. A single word, carved over and over and over: a name.
With the last frayed thread of her clarity, Hella forces herself to look.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sy...nex?
[Dimming Filter + Flickering Golden Light]
Strange Aurum Secretum light blooms from her fingertips. The mournful moans of the alchemic beasts fade into distant echoes as the world around her dissolves.
She seems to have touched a fragment of someone's soul. Her consciousness plunges into an endless dream—vast, weightless.
